name: Atlantis (STS-45)
about: Atlantis (STS-45) (1992-015A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1992 Mar 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1992 Mar 26), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
